---
name: Demo request
about: Suggest a concept worth a demo
labels: enhancement
---

**The concept**
One concept per demo — if it needs a second idea to make sense, that is probably
two demos.

**Which engine**
Bevy, Godot, or bracket-lib. Cross-engine pairs are welcome: nine concepts exist
in both suites so a reader can compare an ECS against a scene tree.

**Why it is worth reading**
What would someone learn that the [existing demos](https://github.com/matthewscottconroy/tiny-rust-games/blob/main/web/catalogue.html)
do not already cover?

**What could be tested without an engine**
The convention is that logic lives in free `pub fn`s that name no engine type.
If a concept resists that, say so — it is interesting in itself.
